description: This file defines the ExpiringTimerBuilder class, which constructs and manages timers with automatic expiration after a specified maximum duration. It includes methods for adding tags, setting expiration handling, and starting timers, ensuring timers do not run indefinitely.

classes.name: ExpiringTimerBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating timers that automatically expire after a maximum duration, ensuring no timer runs indefinitely and allowing custom expiration handling.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Adds multiple tags to the timer, overriding existing tags with the same keys.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds a single tag to the timer, overriding if the key exists.

methods.name: expirationHandling
methods.description: Sets custom handling logic to execute when the timer expires.

methods.name: maximumDuration
methods.description: Sets the maximum duration for the timer before automatic expiration.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Starts the timer and schedules expiration handling after the maximum duration.

methods.name: cancelScheduledExpirationFuture
methods.description: Cancels the scheduled expiration task if the timer is stopped before timeout.

methods.name: defaultExpirationHandling
methods.description: Default logic executed upon timer expiration, including optional custom handling and stopping the timer.
